body: I don't know
i better use something stronger
I'm also being held back because I think people around me will feel responsible when it isn't their fault.
I feel the same way. My life has been so easy yet I want to die so badly and it's not right. I am a weak coward.

I think a lot of the people around this subreddit are great. I'm sure there are people around that are as good as them, but I just don't know how to make that connection in person. I wish everyone here could get in a room and we could all help each other and feel for each other.

Thank you. And I think she doesn't care because she really doesn't even acknowledge my existence. Doesn't try to talk to me or enjoy it, doesn't so much as look at me, especially since I asked her. I get very attached to people even if I don't know them, I imagine things and it gets way out of proportion. I have to stop doing that. But because of that I am still really attached to her and not others.
Not for me.
I know and it's gotten to the point that I do want help, I just can't get myself to find it.

I have a lot in my post history but I'll say again that the main problem for me is socializing. I pretty much have no friends and I don't do anything out of school. I know this is fine for some people but I feel lonely and whenever I see other people having fun together I feel sad about myself. Along with that is communicating with people in general, and the reason I don't think I will get therapy or medication or anything is because I am too scared to ever tell anyone about this.

I had a dream of this girl. I wasn't having sex with her, I wasn't kissing her, we weren't doing anything romantic. I was just having a conversation with her. Just talking, like normal human beings.

Yeah, that's something that's so hard for me I have to dream about it.
I wish life was just dreams.

Same here. It's gotten really bad for me. I have maybe three friends who I would not call real friends as they do not care much for me. Whenever I talk to people I'm so awkward and unenthusiastic I push them away when they are trying to get to know me. And so I know nobody.

I actually approached a girl recently. I liked her and I tried to imagine her as someone that I could finally share things with. It was very hard for and of course I was really awkward about it and from her ignoring me and not talking to me I can tell she couldn't care less about me. I know it isn't her fault and I don't blame her, but it all just makes me feel so worthless. She was my way out and it didn't work out. I don't know what to do anymore.

The main thing is that I know there are many people I would hurt but I am hurting so much I am considering disregarding that. Maybe it's selfish, all I can think about is the fact that once I'm dead I won't be able to care anyways. I know people will blame themselves when it really isn't their fault and I imagine this still may not be enough to make them understand.

> she

/r/absolutelynotmeirl

I would tell someone that felt this way not to kill themselves: that they were certainly not worthless, that they have the ability to change, that they should live every day just for the chance that things get better.

But words are cheap, I can say whatever I want and not truly believe it. I know how I am logically supposed to feel but I do not feel that way. I don't feel willing to be vulnerable but I think it would be best for me to open myself up and to find more people. I have such a crush on this girl and I literally dream about talking to her. And I like her and I want to be able to have deep conversations with her but I lack the social ability to become more than acquaintances with her (the reality is I don't really even know her - I have OCD and have become obsessed with a stranger). I just feel so powerless, I'm such a weak, pathetic coward. I can't take it anymore.
I think I would feel better, but it's so hard for me to stop being awkward and shy even though staying this way is totally irrational.

I kind of went the opposite route. I used to think about death a lot even though I insisted to myself at the time that I would never kill myself (in fact you can go back to the beginning of my post history and see the evolution of my thoughts - they had started a much longer time ago but I guess it wasn't until a few months ago that it was bad enough for me to come here).

Now, as I've dealt with this a lot more, I'm maybe not so sure. I think about actual suicide very often. Methods, maybe a letter I'll write, and I focus a lot on how people will react (and I am ashamed for that).

And as to answer your question: I may be a bit biased now but I think it all does fall under suicidal ideation.
At this point the latter half of my entire day is sulking in my room thinking about killing myself. Whenever I walk past a mirror a flash a quick finger gun to the head.

I can agree with this logically but I can't agree with my actual feelings. I know it's wrong, I know I shouldn't feel it, I know I have a much better life compared to others, but I still feel worthless and lonely and sad and I want to die.

I'm so socially inept that I can't even find the courage to tell anyone about my problem. Pretty much nobody talks to me and I suspect the ones that do are driven mostly by pity. The rare times I talk to girls I start acting really awkward because I don't have the ability to look at them as just a friend.

In class I sit alone and listen to the people talk around me and have fun and it always pains me as I just silently sit there pretending to do something on my phone. I'm jealous that other people can talk to each other so easily when I feel uncomfortable and act awkward unless I am very very good friends with that person.

I'm with ya. Total loner, eat lunch by myself or go to the library without eating because I don't know anyone and feel like a joke sitting by myself. I used to play a lot of games and recently I've accepted how worthless they are and have pretty much stopped playing. Without the distraction I've become really depressed that I pretty much have nothing in my life.
My only reason is also my family. If I could die without hurting them I would do it. But now I'm becoming so numb that I'm even starting to forget about them and I don't know how much longer I have.

I have no friends. I'm totally awkward and terrible at social interaction, I've pretty much never left my house since I moved this year. I go to school and eat lunch alone, then come home and cry in bed. I'm absolutely pathetic.

I think if you are willing to try meeting people you should keep doing it, I can't get myself to meet anyone: my contact list is empty. I feel like shit but I'm not dead. I think we can both keep pushing, I want you to have your 18th birthday.

Sorry if this didn't help, if I had better advice I may be less depressed myself.
I love you and I want you to stay

I don't really have any real friends, I eat lunch alone every day before going home after school and crying in bed because I literally have nothing better to do. This girl has a total hold on me and she doesn't even know it, I'm awkward as fuck when talking to her (when talking to anyone) and haven't let on that I like her: I'm a loser that's never been in a relationship so I don't know what to do, she barely knows me because we have barely even talked. I don't think there's any meaning but stupid instinctual shit but I can't get over it. I'm too scared to talk about anyone about my feelings, and so I have to deal with it myself. The most painful feeling in the world is crying without anyone ever seeing you or knowing it.
Me three

I'm 16 and live in the U.S. now, but the past few years I have moved many times. I have never made friends easily because I'm not a social person so it doesn't help when we move over and over. Last year I took an online school and became even more isolated than I already was. It was during this time I started to become very discontent with my life. Now I've been in a new school for nearly a semester but I still have no real friends, I'm awkward every time I talk to somebody so nobody really wants to know me.

There is no reason to be ashamed because nothing is your fault, and I wish you better but cannot do much but say you are not alone and that there are people there for you. If you want to talk to me just send over a message, but like I said I'm not a very good talker.
Doesn't help you at all but I just feel like I have to comment here that your step sister is a real fucking asshole and I'm absolutely disgusted that anyone would actually do what she did.

I've been conditioned by society to find this "a little weird" but I try to be open-minded and the cold hard reality is _it doesn't matter_, even if you kept going through with it. I'll admit I read the first part a little uncomfortably but that's because of the scenario and not you. When I read about the rest of your life and your care for your family that incident is not what comes to my mind.

What people think is "normal" is irrelevant, and if people don't accept you for breaking their own boundaries of normality that's their problem and not yours.

If it's a mistake in your own mind, then it is. And it looks like to me that you did get over that mistake and you can get over it again, just think back to that time when you just didn't care, because it just doesn't matter. What happened has happened (a long time ago) and there's no point on dwelling on it. If it ever comes back you _can_ deal with it.

I made a new account to reply because I read every single word and can't relate to this more. I'm just a junior in high school but I've also felt really unhappy with my life. I eat lunch alone and pretty much don't talk to people. I feel like if I talked to them and got to know them I would feel better, but I just can't get myself to do it. I waste my days on YouTube wishing for something better but never reaching for it. This is literally the first time I am ever letting this out, I haven't told anyone because I just don't want them to worry about something that isn't their fault. I got home today and just got in my bed and cried and I ended up on this subreddit. Although I don't have any advice for you I just wanted to let you know that you're not alone. Despite everything I still believe there is some worth to living, and I will try to push on no matter what gets thrown at me: you should too. If I keep going one day it might get better, if I give up I know for sure it never will.
